metadata.title: Disentangling Teacher and Lesson Variance and Their Relations to Supportive Learning Environments: A Machine Learning Assessment of Teacher Nonverbal Behavior

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study does not use plausible values because the dependent variables are teacher nonverbal immediacy scores, not ILSA cognitive achievement plausible values.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study explicitly states that it did not apply sampling weights in the analysis.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study does not provide information indicating that it used multilevel modeling or accounted for school clustering in its analysis.
design_fields.q4_rationale: There is no mention of any validation strategy beyond the estimation sample, such as external validation or cross-validation.
